the haircut is good but unfortunately the girl working there is not only rude but she has no patience to work with dogs, my dog was screaming and howling for 1 hour while she was grooming her and the girl was just yelling at her every now and then. After she finished she just told me took her to a trainer! her way was very blunt and rude, and at home my dog never screams like that, she doesn't damage anything and she stays home exceptionally well as she sleeps all day while I'm at work.
Totally didn't like this girl never there again!

Our dog has been a guest here several times, even when he was very little. He loves being here. When we arrive and get out of the car, he already scratches the door to say "let me in!" 🤣 The people working here are very kind and helpful! I really feel that they are there to make the dog feel good and the owner feel calm. …
Great place! Friendly service and they speak English very well. Most importantly, I left with two 'brand new' dogs after their haircuts. Thank you for the professional work! :)
We chose you for our puppy's first grooming session and it was the best decision! Precise, flawless work and an incredibly kind and loving attitude. Thank you on behalf of Huba too❤️
They work very nicely and precisely, my dog ​​turned out very cute 🐾 …
Speed, professionalism, kindness and fair prices, I was very satisfied, we will definitely return with my dog. 😊 …
Cultured, beautiful, sophisticated work every time.
We love this cosmetics, we searched for the best place for a long time but now we have found it.

Very nice place
Strongly to recommend
